    d = df.copy()
    # normalize text label variants (whitespace / case)
    for c in ['species', 'island', 'sex']:
        if c in d.columns:
            d[c] = d[c].astype('string').str.strip()
    d['species'] = d['species'].str.title()
    d['island'] = d['island'].str.capitalize()
    d['sex'] = d['sex'].str.lower()
    # numbers written as text (with thousands separators) -> numeric
    for c in ['bill_length_mm', 'bill_depth_mm', 'flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']:
        if c in d.columns:
            d[c] = pd.to_numeric(d[c].astype('string').str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(), errors='coerce')
    # enforce allowed ranges for the measures used
    d = d[(d['body_mass_g'].notna()) & (d['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (d['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    d = d[(d['bill_length_mm'].isna()) | ((d['bill_length_mm'] >= 30) & (d['bill_length_mm'] <= 60))]
    d = d[(d['flipper_length_mm'].isna()) | ((d['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (d['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235))]
    # drop rows with unknown sex (missing group key)
    d = d[d['sex'].isin(['male', 'female'])]

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    g = d.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): round(float(v), 2) for k, v in g.items()}
